action.selector_mapping: The null-target selector is the known operation type. A nonnull selector is type plus @ plus the exact target ID. Decoding looks up the entire string in a rebuilt server codebook; it never splits IDs or guesses a target.

resource_bounds.policy: Engineering limits, not vendor quota claims. Oversized schemas are refused as a whole, never truncated.
